description: Apartments or houses for sale in a Polish city, cheapest first, from both markets: the primary market (new builds from statutory developer price lists) and the secondary market (listings). Filter by market, maximum price, area and price per m2. Each result has market, source, price, price per m2, area, address, developer and investment for new builds, the price list date, and a cityon.pl link. Developer price lists do not include the number of rooms or the floor. Mieszkania lub domy na sprzedaż w mieście, od najtańszych, z rynku pierwotnego (wykazy cen deweloperów) i wtórnego (ogłoszenia). Filtry: rynek, cena maksymalna, metraż, cena za m2. Wykazy nie podają liczby pokoi.

city.description: City or town in Poland, e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow". Miasto lub miejscowość, np. "Kraków".

limit.description: Max results, 1 to 20. Liczba wyników, od 1 do 20.

market.description: primary = new builds from developers, secondary = resale. pierwotny lub wtórny.

max_area_m2.description: Max area in m2. Metraż maks.

max_price.description: Max total price in PLN. Cena maks. w zł.

max_price_per_m2.description: Max price per m2 in PLN. Cena maks. za m2.

min_area_m2.description: Min area in m2. Metraż min.

name: search_properties
title: Apartments and houses for sale / Mieszkania i domy na sprzedaż
